title: Static-call model catalog identity interface first
changes: Added typed ControllerStaticCallModelClassIdentity evidence and a versioned ControllerStaticCallModelClassIdentityRuleInterface.
Static class origin now resolves only against a unique model identity from scanned ModelDefinition values; unknown classes are not applicable and duplicate short identities are unresolved.
Wired the canonical model class catalog from laravelSourceAstPipeline through LaravelControllerScanInput, action resolution, and controller dataflow evidence.
Preserved existing invocation, integrated response, response attribute, AST rule, and resource binding authorities; no relation/foundation subscanner or parallel authority added.
zip_integrity: will be recorded after archive creation
known_limitations: PHP import-alias and fully-qualified class-reference resolution is not yet modeled as a closed judgment; the current catalog match is exact against model short-name evidence and rejects ambiguity.
